owner.label: Owner
owner.hint: Can do everything, including deleting the workspace

admin.label: Assistant
admin.hint: Invites and removes members, assigns work, deletes projects

estimator.label: Estimator
estimator.hint: Creates and fills in projects, saves revisions

viewer.label: Viewer
viewer.hint: Views and exports the BOQ, cannot edit

pm.label: Project manager
pm.hint: Runs projects, budgets, purchasing and site work, approves subcontractor claims

purchasing.label: Purchasing
purchasing.hint: Requests, orders and receives materials, manages suppliers

accounting.label: Accounting
accounting.hint: Bills customers, records receipts and payments, taxes and financial reports

foreman.label: Foreman
foreman.hint: Daily site reports, labour records and receiving goods on site
